aiConsent\u0000title: Can Muntej use AI on your data?
aiConsent\u0000intro: Muntej uses AI to understand your tasks, write replies, turn voice into text and read files. To do that, some of your data is sent to our AI provider. Nothing is sent until you allow it.
aiConsent\u0000what1: What you type or say to Muntej, including voice recordings
aiConsent\u0000what2: Names, job titles and skills of the people on your team
aiConsent\u0000what3: Task details: titles, goals, steps and dates
aiConsent\u0000what4: Proof photos and files you attach to a task
aiConsent\u0000what5: Org charts, files and lists you upload to build your team
aiConsent\u0000what6: Only if you connect them: emails, chats and meetings from Gmail, Outlook, Teams or WhatsApp
aiConsent\u0000who: OpenAI (USA), through Muntej’s servers. OpenAI uses it only to answer Muntej’s request, doesn’t use it to train its models, and protects it as our privacy policy describes.
aiConsent\u0000choice: If you choose “Not now”, Muntej still works: you create and follow tasks by hand, and the AI parts stay off. You can change this anytime in Settings → AI assistant.
aiConsent\u0000failed: Couldn’t save your choice. Check your connection and try again.
aiConsent\u0000settingOn: On: what you type or say, task details and files you attach are sent to OpenAI to understand and answer them.
aiConsent\u0000settingOff: Off: nothing of yours is sent to OpenAI. Voice, the chat assistant and reading your tools are paused.
aiConsent\u0000settingDetails: What is sent and to whom
aiConsent\u0000offBody: You chose not to send your data to OpenAI, so the assistant can’t read this. You can still create the task by hand.
aiConsent\u0000blocked: AI is off for your account. Allow it in Settings → AI assistant, or do this by hand.

proto\u0000openHint: All 37 screens in one place, with tips.
proto\u0000d01: Voice-first home: say a task, see what Muntej is handling, the decisions waiting and the team’s energy this week.
proto\u0000d02: Muntej shows what it understood from one sentence (owner, due, priority, helper, goal, reward) and its follow-up plan.
proto\u0000d03: A read-only feed of everything Muntej did for you: reminders, updates received, meetings set, points awarded.
proto\u0000d04: Only exceptions reach the manager, each with an AI recommendation and one-tap approve, decline or voice reply.
proto\u0000d05: A 60-second audio summary, hours saved, team pulse and one suggestion you can accept with one tap.
proto\u0000d06: Employees get tasks and follow-ups in chat and update with one tap, earning points as they go.
proto\u0000d07: After a meeting, every spoken commitment becomes a suggested task with the exact quote and timestamp.
proto\u0000d08: An employee can say "my plate is full"; Muntej asks the manager a face-saving priority question for them.
proto\u0000d09: Employees see what they are waiting on, even their manager, and ask Muntej to nudge politely.
proto\u0000d10: Progress is read from real signals instead of self-reporting, and Muntej offers help when someone looks stuck.
proto\u0000d11: When assigning, see everyone’s load and the impact of the new task, with the best fit recommended.
proto\u0000d12: Connect WhatsApp, email, meetings, Teams, Slack, Google Chat, Jira, Azure DevOps and sticky notes; updates sync back.
proto\u0000d13: Meeting bots for Zoom, Meet and Teams plus recording devices for in-room meetings, capturing tasks live.
proto\u0000d14: Clarity rate, AI split into subtasks, evidence attachments and the reward for finishing well.
proto\u0000d15: Rate the work, approve or send back with a note, round by round until done, with points awarded on approval.
proto\u0000d16: Daily, weekly and monthly KPIs compared with the previous period, plus engagement and one AI insight.
proto\u0000d17: One-tap summary for any project, product or employee, with AI-drafted feedback for employees.
proto\u0000d18: Channels, alert rules, quiet hours (prayer times, Ramadan) and smart escalation.
proto\u0000d19: Each product is a workspace with its people, health, weekly wins and points. No boards or columns.
proto\u0000d20: Describe a product in one sentence and AI picks the team with a match score and reason.
proto\u0000d21: A one-page timeline of real wins, by workspace or by employee, with week / month / quarter zoom.
proto\u0000d22: Routines that run by themselves, scheduled or event-based, with on/off toggles.
